author: Enough-Bike7525
body:
Honestly, just ask the guy you see while at work whether it's him or not. If it is the person, awesome! If it's not, well, maybe you can convert him to the Orna-verse.

I walk a lot with my job and control most of my town.... I had a customer come to me and ask if I played Orna (my username alludes to my profession). It was a pretty awesome moment, he was like, me and my wife play and we see you everywhere (territory control). They don't play anymore but I still say hey to them when I see them and try to get them to come back to the game, extolling all the new updates and what not.

Here's to hoping the person is cool and ya connect!
